user.description:
To connect you need a Google oauth_token:

1. Open the [Google EmbeddedSetup sign-in page]({embedded_setup_url}) and sign in with the Google account that manages your Wifi network. The page may appear blank or keep loading forever - that is normal.
2. Open the browser developer tools (press F12, or right-click the page and choose Inspect).
3. Go to the Application tab (Chrome/Edge) or Storage tab (Firefox) and open Cookies -> {accounts_url}.
4. Find the cookie named 'oauth_token' and copy its ENTIRE value - it starts with oauth2_4/.
5. Paste it into the token field below with your Google account email.

Advanced: you can paste an existing master token (starts with aas_et/ or oauth2rt_1/) instead of the oauth_token cookie.

reauth_confirm.description:
Your Google Wifi credentials are no longer valid.

1. Open the [Google EmbeddedSetup sign-in page]({embedded_setup_url}) and sign in with the Google account that manages your Wifi network.
2. Open developer tools (F12), go to Application -> Cookies -> {accounts_url} and copy the entire 'oauth_token' cookie value (starts with oauth2_4/).
3. Paste it below with your Google account email.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Google. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Google rejected these credentials. Check the email is correct and the token was copied in full, then sign in again for a fresh token - the oauth_token only works once.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Check the Home Assistant log for details.
